description: Master structure for Spanish learning curriculum — 6 levels, 10 themes per level, 60 themes total

a1-1.title: A1.1 — Survival Spanish
a1-1.description: The absolute basics: greetings, introductions, numbers, colors, family, daily routines. You can introduce yourself, order food, and handle basic social interactions.

themes.title: Greetings & Introductions
themes.description: Hello, goodbye, how are you, introduce yourself, basic social rituals

themes.title: Numbers & Colors
themes.description: Count 0-100, colors, quantities, sizes, describe objects

themes.title: Family & People
themes.description: Family tree, describe people, possessives, friends, acquaintances

themes.title: Daily Routines
themes.description: Wake up, eat, work, exercise, sleep — reflexive verbs, time-telling

themes.title: Food & Drink
themes.description: Fruits, vegetables, meat, beverages, meals, ordering at restaurants

themes.title: Home & House
themes.description: Rooms, furniture, household objects, prepositions of place

themes.title: City & Places
themes.description: City landmarks, asking for directions, transportation, neighborhoods

themes.title: Weather & Seasons
themes.description: Weather conditions, seasons, temperature, climate expressions

themes.title: Clothing & Appearance
themes.description: Clothing items, accessories, physical description, size adjectives

themes.title: Animals & Nature
themes.description: Animals, nature elements, outdoor spaces, basic nature vocabulary

a1-2.title: A1.2 — Everyday Spanish
a1-2.description: Expand your range: shopping, time, calendar, health basics, entertainment, social interactions. Handle most daily situations confidently.

themes.title: Shopping & Prices
themes.description: Stores, clothes shopping, prices, bargaining, payments

themes.title: Travel & Transportation
themes.description: Airports, hotels, directions, renting cars, public transport

themes.title: Health & Body
themes.description: Body parts, health problems, pharmacy, doctor visits

themes.title: Entertainment & Leisure
themes.description: Movies, music, hobbies, sports, free time activities

themes.title: Time & Calendar
themes.description: Days, months, dates, seasons, scheduling, temporal expressions

themes.title: Work & Jobs
themes.description: Professions, workplace, job search, professional introductions

themes.title: Technology & Communication
themes.description: Phone, email, internet, social media, tech objects

themes.title: Sports & Activities
themes.description: Sports names, exercises, equipment, teams, competition

themes.title: Education & School
themes.description: School subjects, classroom objects, teachers, learning

themes.title: Social Interactions
themes.description: Invitations, plans, agreements, disagreements, social phrases

a2-1.title: A2.1 — Expanded Daily Life
a2-1.description: Past tenses, extended narratives, cultural topics, complex social situations, environment, media, relationships.

themes.title: Past Experiences & Stories
themes.description: Preterite and imperfect, storytelling, life experiences, past narratives

themes.title: Plans & Future Intentions
themes.description: Future tense, going to, intentions, predictions, plans

themes.title: Culture & Traditions
themes.description: Festivals, customs, traditions, cultural references, holidays

themes.title: Environment & Nature
themes.description: Nature conservation, weather extremes, geography, animals

themes.title: Media & News
themes.description: TV, radio, newspapers, internet news, social media, journalism

themes.title: Relationships & Social Life
themes.description: Friendships, dating, family dynamics, social obligations

themes.title: Law & Rights
themes.description: Basic legal terms, rights, duties, bureaucracy, documents

themes.title: Science & Technology
themes.description: Basic science, inventions, technology in daily life, innovation

themes.title: Economy & Business
themes.description: Money, banking, shopping, basic economics, commerce

themes.title: Arts & Literature
themes.description: Art forms, literature, music, cinema, creative expression

a2-2.title: A2.2 — Social & Professional Spanish
a2-2.description: Complex social interactions, health and wellness, career development, politics, sustainability, advanced daily life.

themes.title: Advanced Travel Scenarios
themes.description: Complex travel situations, emergencies, accommodations, navigation

themes.title: Complex Social Interactions
themes.description: Negotiations, opinions, persuasion, social etiquette

themes.title: Health & Wellness
themes.description: Mental health, fitness, nutrition, preventive care, wellness

themes.title: Education & Career Development
themes.description: University, professional development, interviews, networking

themes.title: Politics & Society
themes.description: Government, elections, social issues, citizenship, rights

themes.title: Entertainment & Media Consumption
themes.description: Streaming, gaming, books, films, cultural consumption

themes.title: Environment & Sustainability
themes.description: Climate change, recycling, conservation, sustainable living

themes.title: Technology & Innovation
themes.description: AI, smartphones, apps, digital transformation, innovation

themes.title: Economy & Finance
themes.description: Personal finance, investments, taxes, economic systems

themes.title: Arts, Culture & Heritage
themes.description: Museums, historical sites, cultural identity, heritage preservation

b1-1.title: B1.1 — Intermediate Spanish
b1-1.description: Abstract thinking, complex travel, professional communication, academic expression, cultural analysis, media, science, society.

themes.title: Abstract Thinking & Opinions
themes.description: Expressing opinions, hypotheses, subjunctive, abstract concepts

themes.title: Complex Travel & Navigation
themes.description: Extended travel narratives, cultural immersion, problem-solving

themes.title: Professional Communication
themes.description: Meetings, presentations, emails, negotiations, business Spanish

themes.title: Academic Expression
themes.description: Essays, reports, research, academic vocabulary, formal writing

themes.title: Cultural Analysis
themes.description: Cultural differences, identity, integration, cross-cultural communication

themes.title: Media & Journalism
themes.description: News analysis, editorial opinion, media literacy, bias detection

themes.title: Science & Innovation
themes.description: Scientific method, research, innovation, technology ethics

themes.title: Society & Community
themes.description: Social structures, community life, civic engagement, diversity

themes.title: Economics & Trade
themes.description: International trade, markets, economic policy, globalization

themes.title: Literature & Arts
themes.description: Literary analysis, art criticism, cultural movements, creativity

b1-2.title: B1.2 — Advanced Intermediate Spanish
b1-2.description: Advanced argumentation, professional negotiation, cultural criticism, academic research, media literacy, scientific communication.

themes.title: Advanced Argumentation
themes.description: Debate, persuasion, logical reasoning, counterarguments

themes.title: Professional Negotiation

themes.title: Cultural Criticism

themes.title: Academic Research
themes.description: Research methods, thesis writing, citations, academic discourse

themes.title: Media Literacy
themes.description: Media analysis, fake news detection, source evaluation, digital ethics

themes.title: Scientific Communication
themes.description: Scientific writing, data presentation, research communication

themes.title: Political Discourse
themes.description: Political analysis, policy debate, international relations

themes.title: Economic Analysis
themes.description: Economic theory, market analysis, financial forecasting

themes.title: Literary Analysis
themes.description: Literary theory, text interpretation, authorial intent, genre analysis

themes.title: Social Commentary
themes.description: Social issues, inequality, justice, human rights, activism
